## Release scope

Maris 0.2.3 integrates the reviewed dependency maintenance following 0.2.2. It provides portable CLI/TUI packages for macOS, Linux and Windows on x86_64 and ARM64 through the existing exact-source native build, offline regression, package integrity and public installation gates.

## Changes

- Update libc to 0.2.191, zerocopy and zerocopy-derive to 0.8.63, and the vendored Candle ZIP pin to 9.0.5.
- Update tokenizers to 0.23.2 and adapt both GGUF special-token registration paths to its owned-iterator API. Propagate registration and normalizer configuration failures.
- Add behavioral GGUF regression tests for existing vocabulary IDs, token-type and explicit-ID special registration, decode filtering, and BOS/EOS insertion.
- Keep updater examples and bundle metadata aligned with 0.2.3, and correct the mixer bus example to use bus 1 (A).
- Retain the existing nonempty command-description and nested help checks.
- Repair branch-cleanup preflight validation of GitHub commit-comparison paths, with offline regressions for path boundaries and mixed-version release evidence.

The incompatible rand 0.10 and rand_distr 0.6 proposals are excluded. The currently published half and float8 distribution implementations use the older random-number API; their migration remains coordinated follow-up work.

## Known limits and unfinished work

These packages are unsigned and have no publisher-signing or macOS notarization claim. Software and installation checks do not establish successful operation on a particular physical audio device or subjective sound quality.

- Physical capture, original-audio muting/restoration, multiple-device clocks, device and power transitions, output loudness and subjective listening acceptance remain unverified. The previously reported Mac Pro no-sound symptom has not been confirmed resolved on the affected hardware.
- The separate GUI application acceptance and signing requirements remain open.
- CPAL/Flexaudio migration is not included. The locked graph retains maintenance advisories for paste, zbus_names, zvariant and zvariant_derive; the unchanged dependency audit gate applies.
- Project licensing remains unspecified; this release does not add a license grant. Included third-party notices retain their own terms and provenance.

The generated changelog below describes committed software changes and does not replace the physical-device and listening acceptance above.
